Northpeak Outdoor Gear: Returns & Refunds Policy > 3. How refunds work
- For a normal return, support **starts the return** (customer gets a prepaid label). The refund is issued **once the warehouse receives the item**, not during the chat.
- Refunds go back to the **original payment method**. The customer **can't choose** a different method (no switching a card refund to store credit or a gift card). The only exceptions are gift card purchases (below) and sale items bought at 40%+ off (section 4).
- Card refunds take **5–7 business days** after we receive the return.
- **Gift card** purchases are refunded as a **new gift card**, never as cash.
- Original shipping costs are **not refunded**, unless the item was damaged or we sent the wrong item.
- Return shipping is **free for Plus members**. Everyone else pays a **$7.95 return shipping fee**, taken out of the refund.

Northpeak Outdoor Gear: Returns & Refunds Policy > 1. Return window
- Most items can be returned within **30 days of the delivery date**.
- **How the 30 days are counted:** the delivery date is **day 1**. The window ends at 11:59 PM PT on **day 30** (60 for Plus).
- Items must be unused, with original tags attached.
- **Northpeak Plus members** get a **60-day** return window.
- Items bought between **Nov 15 and Dec 31** can be returned until **Jan 31** of the next year, or within the normal window, whichever is later.

Northpeak Outdoor Gear: Returns & Refunds Policy > 5. Refund limits
- Support agents can approve refunds up to **$200 per order**.
- Refunds **over $200** must be approved by a manager. The agent should escalate and tell the customer to expect a reply within **2 business days**.
- A customer can get at most **3 refunds in any 90-day period**. After that, all further refund requests must be escalated.

Northpeak Outdoor Gear: Account & Membership Policy > 1. Northpeak Plus membership
- Costs **$49/year**. It auto-renews unless canceled.
- Benefits: 60-day returns, free Standard shipping, free Express on $150+, free return shipping, and early access to sales.
- Members can cancel anytime. A **full refund** is available within **30 days** of signing up or renewing, **only if no member benefits were used**. Otherwise there's no refund, and benefits last until the end of the paid year.

Northpeak Outdoor Gear: Returns & Refunds Policy > 4. Sale items
- Items bought at **40% off or more** (but not marked Final Sale) can be returned for **store credit only**, not a refund to the card.

Northpeak Outdoor Gear: Warranty Policy > 1. What's covered
- **Northpeak-brand** products have a **2-year warranty** against defects in materials and workmanship, starting from the delivery date.
- **Other brands** we sell follow the **manufacturer's warranty**. We'll point the customer to the manufacturer, but we don't handle those claims.

Northpeak Outdoor Gear: Warranty Policy > 3. How a claim works
1. The customer sends photos of the defect and their order number.
2. Support reviews the claim. Simple claims under **$100** can be approved by an agent.
3. Claims **$100 or more** go to the warranty team (escalate). Decision within **5 business days**.
4. If approved, we **repair** the item first. If it can't be repaired, we **replace** it. If it's no longer sold, we give **store credit** for the original price.
- Warranty claims never get a cash or card refund.

Northpeak Outdoor Gear: Warranty Policy > 2. What's not covered
- Normal wear and tear (faded colors, worn soles).
- Damage from accidents, misuse, or improper care (e.g. machine-drying a down jacket).
- Items that were modified or repaired by someone else.
- Items bought from **unauthorized resellers** (eBay, etc.).

Northpeak Outdoor Gear: Returns & Refunds Policy > 7. Damaged or wrong items
- Report damaged or wrong items within **14 days of delivery**, with at least **one photo**. This applies to **all items, including Final Sale**.
- These get a full refund **including original shipping**, and no return fee. Like any return, the item must be **shipped back first** (free prepaid label). The refund is issued once the warehouse receives it.
- **How the 14 days are counted:** the delivery date is **day 1**. The window ends at 11:59 PM PT on **day 14**. Example: delivered Nov 1, so report by Nov 14.
- Reports after 14 days are handled under the Warranty Policy instead.

Northpeak Outdoor Gear: Warranty Policy > 4. Lifetime warranty
- **Northpeak Summit Series** products have a **lifetime warranty** for the original owner.
- It does **not transfer** if the item is sold or given away.
